blocks.text: Yeh chapter 18 (Quantum Physics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) aur numerical problems ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Tick (✓) the correct answer. (Sahi jawab par nishaan lagayein.)

blocks.prompt:
18.1 Which particle is emitted when UV light is made incident on a zinc surface?
(Jab zinc ki satah par UV light daali jaye to kaun sa zarra kharij hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: UV light ki frequency zinc ki threshold frequency (kam se kam zaroori frequency) se zyada hai, is liye photon electron ko metal se bahar nikaal deta hai. Yeh photoelectric effect hai aur nikalne wale zarre electrons (photoelectrons) hain.

blocks.prompt:
18.2 The wave nature of electrons is supported by experiments on:
(Electrons ki wave nature kin experiments se sabit hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diffraction (moorna/phailna) sirf waves ki khasiyat hai. Davisson aur Germer ne dikhaya ke electrons nickel crystal se bilkul X-rays ki tarah diffract hote hain, aur un ka wavelength de Broglie ke formula λ = h/mv ke mutabiq tha. Photoelectric effect to light ki particle nature dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt:
18.3 The dimensions of Planck's constant are same as that of:
(Planck's constant ki dimensions kis ki dimensions jaisi hain?)
blocks.explanation: h = E/f, is ki unit J s = kg m² s⁻¹ yani [ML²T⁻¹]. Angular momentum L = mvr ki unit bhi kg m² s⁻¹ (J s) hai. Momentum ki unit kg m s⁻¹ aur torque ki N m = kg m² s⁻² hai, is liye sahi jawab angular momentum hai.

blocks.prompt:
18.4 Which of the following has the most energetic photons?
(In mein se kis ke photons sab se zyada energy wale hain?)
blocks.explanation: Photon ki energy E = hf hai. Gamma rays ki frequency sab se zyada (wavelength sab se chhota) hai, is liye un ke photons sab se zyada energy rakhte hain.

blocks.prompt:
18.5 de-Broglie waves are associated with:
(de-Broglie waves kin zarron ke saath hoti hain?)

options.text: all particles whether in motion or at rest

blocks.explanation: λ = h/mv har harkat karte hue zarre par lagta hai, chahe charged ho (electron, proton) ya neutral (neutron, atom). Rukay hue zarre ke liye v = 0 hai, is liye koi wavelength nahi banta.

blocks.prompt:
18.6 An electron microscope employ the principle:
(Electron microscope kis usool (principle) par kaam karta hai? (Sahi parhai: An electron microscope employs the principle: electrons have a wave nature ...))

options.text: electron can be focused by an electric field
electron can be focused by a magnetic field

blocks.explanation: Electron microscope electrons ki wave nature istemal karta hai (bohat chhota de Broglie wavelength, is liye bohat baareek tafseel nazar aati hai). Electron beam ko fields se bane lenses focus karte hain: electromagnetic (magnetic) lens, aur kuch microscopes mein electric (electrostatic) lens. Is liye teeno baatein sahi hain: all of the above.

blocks.prompt:
18.7 Electron, proton, neutron and alpha particle, all have the same speed, which particle will have the shortest wavelength?
(Electron, proton, neutron aur alpha particle sab ki speed barabar ho to kis ka wavelength sab se chhota hoga?)
blocks.explanation: λ = h/mv. Speed barabar ho to λ ∝ 1/m, yani jitna bhaari zarra, utna chhota wavelength. Alpha particle (2 protons + 2 neutrons) proton se taqreeban chaar guna bhaari hai, is liye us ka wavelength sab se chhota hai.

blocks.prompt:
18.8 The Balmer series is obtained when all the transitions of electrons terminate at:
(Balmer series tab banti hai jab electrons ki sab transitions (chhalaang) kis level par khatam hon?)
blocks.explanation: Balmer series: 1/λ = R_H(1/2² − 1/n²), n = 3, 4, 5, ... Sab transitions n = 2 par khatam hoti hain. (Lyman n = 1 par, Paschen n = 3 par.)

blocks.prompt:
18.9 The spectrum in which different colours are not diffused into each other and are separated by dark spaces is usually known as:
(Woh spectrum jis mein rang aapas mein mile hue nahi hote aur andheri jagahon se alag hote hain, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Line spectrum mein alag alag tez (sharp) roshan lines andheri background par nazar aati hain, jaise discharge tube mein elements ke vapours se. Continuous spectrum mein rang ek doosre mein mil jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
18.10 Using uncertainty principle, it can be proved that:
(Uncertainty principle ki madad se kya sabit kiya ja sakta hai?)

options.text: electron lies out of the nucleus
there is always uncertainty in measuring accurately energy and momentum for atomic particles

blocks.explanation: Chapter mein Δx Δp ≈ h se sabit kiya gaya hai ke electron nucleus ke andar nahi ho sakta: Δx ≈ 10⁻¹⁵ m lein to Δp ≈ 6.63 × 10⁻¹⁹ kg m s⁻¹, jis ke liye GeV darje ki energy chahiye; atom mein aisa electron nahi milta, is liye electron nucleus ke bahar hota hai. Option (d) sabit shuda natija nahi; principle position-momentum (aur energy-time) ke bare mein hai, energy aur momentum dono ke bare mein nahi.

blocks.prompt:
18.11 According to uncertainty principle, in order to observe the position of an electron with greater accuracy, we must use light of:
(Uncertainty principle ke mutabiq electron ki position zyada durust dekhne ke liye kaisi light istemal karni chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Position sirf light ke taqreeban ek wavelength tak maloom ho sakti hai (Δx ≈ λ). Chhota wavelength chhota Δx deta hai, magar us ke photon ka momentum h/λ zyada hota hai, is liye momentum ki uncertainty (ghair yaqeeniyat) barh jati hai.

blocks.text: Short Answer Questions (mukhtasar jawab)

blocks.prompt:
18.1 How energy of a pocket is related to its frequency according to quantum theory? Describe briefly.
Quantum theory ke mutabiq energy ke packet (quantum) ki energy us ki frequency se kaise mutaliq hai? Mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Quantum theory ke mutabiq radiation chhote chhote packets (quanta ya photons) mein kharij ya jazb hoti hai. Har packet ki energy us ki frequency ke barah-e-raast mutanasib (directly proportional) hai:
E = hf
jahan h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s Planck's constant hai. Zyada frequency = zyada energy wala packet.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "pocket" chhapa hai; sahi lafz "packet" hai (energy ka packet, yani quantum).

blocks.prompt:
18.2 How does the photoelectric current vary with intensity of incident light on a metal surface?
Metal ki satah par parne wali light ki intensity (shiddat) ke saath photoelectric current kaise badalta hai?
blocks.explanation: Threshold frequency se zyada frequency ki light ke liye photoelectric current light ki intensity ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai. Zyada intensity = zyada photons, is liye har second zyada electrons nikalte hain. Stopping potential (yani maximum K.E.) intensity se nahi badalta. Threshold frequency se kam frequency par light kitni bhi tez ho, current nahi chalta.

blocks.prompt:
18.3 Which has more energy, a photon of UV radiation or a photon of yellow light? Describe briefly.
UV radiation ka photon zyada energy rakhta hai ya peeli (yellow) light ka? Mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
UV radiation ka photon. Photon ki energy E = hf = hc/λ hai, aur UV ki frequency yellow light se zyada (wavelength chhota) hai.
Misal: yellow light (577 nm): E ≈ 3.4 × 10⁻¹⁹ J ≈ 2.2 eV; UV (300 nm): E ≈ 6.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J ≈ 4.1 eV.

blocks.prompt:
18.4 Is work function of a metal related to threshold frequency in a photoelectric emission?
Kya metal ka work function photoelectric emission mein threshold frequency se mutaliq hai?
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Work function woh kam se kam energy hai jo electron ko metal se azaad karne ke liye chahiye; threshold frequency f₀ wale photon ki energy bilkul itni hoti hai (K.E.max = 0):
φ = hf₀
Yani jis metal ka work function zyada ho, us ki threshold frequency bhi zyada hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
18.5 Explain briefly, why we can observe the wave-like properties of electrons but not of a flying tennis ball.
Mukhtasar wazahat karein ke hum electrons ki wave jaisi khasiyat dekh sakte hain magar urti hui tennis ball ki nahi, kyun?
blocks.explanation: de Broglie wavelength λ = h/mv. Electron ki mass bohat kam hai, is liye us ka wavelength (taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m) crystal mein atoms ke faasle jitna hai aur us ka diffraction dekha ja sakta hai. Tennis ball ki mass bohat zyada hai, is liye us ka wavelength intehai chhota hai (misal: 0.06 kg, 30 m s⁻¹: λ ≈ 3.7 × 10⁻³⁴ m), jis ka koi diffraction ya interference nazar nahi aa sakta.

blocks.prompt:
18.6 Radiation with a certain frequency causes electrons to be emitted from the surface of one metal and not from the surface of another metal. Why?
Ek khaas frequency ki radiation ek metal se electrons nikaalti hai magar doosre metal se nahi. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Har metal ka work function, aur is liye threshold frequency (φ = hf₀), alag hoti hai. Radiation ki frequency pehle metal ki threshold frequency se zyada hai (hf > φ₁), is liye electrons nikalte hain; doosre metal ki threshold frequency se kam hai (hf < φ₂), is liye radiation kitni bhi tez ho, electron nahi nikalta.

blocks.prompt:
18.7 Will high frequency light has more number of electrons than a low frequency light? Describe briefly.
Kya zyada frequency wali light kam frequency wali light se zyada electrons nikaalti hai? Mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Nikalne wale photoelectrons ki tadaad light ki intensity (har second photons ki tadaad) par munhasir hai, frequency par nahi, basharte frequency threshold se zyada ho. Zyada frequency sirf maximum kinetic energy barhati hai: K.E.max = hf − φ. (Intensity barabar ho to mukhtalif frequencies se current barabar aata hai; Fig. 18.3.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal yun chhapa hai jaise light ke andar electrons hon. Sahi matlab: "Kya zyada frequency wali light kam frequency wali light se zyada electrons nikaalti (eject karti) hai?" (aur "has" ki jagah "have" hona chahiye).

blocks.prompt:
18.8 When does light behave as a wave and when does it behaves as consisted of particles?
Light kab wave ki tarah aur kab zarron (particles) ki tarah bartao karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Light source se detector tak safar karte hue wave ki tarah bartao karti hai: interference, diffraction aur polarization is ka saboot hain. Jab light matter (maadde) se takrati hai to photons (zarron) ki tarah bartao karti hai: photoelectric effect, Compton effect aur pair production is ka saboot hain. Ek hi experiment mein dono roop ek saath nazar nahi aate (principle of complementarity).

blocks.prompt:
18.9 Name two possible spectral line series in the spectrum of atomic hydrogen. In which region of electromagnetic spectrum each lies?
Hydrogen atom ke spectrum ki do spectral line series ke naam batayein. Har ek electromagnetic spectrum ke kis hisse mein hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Lyman series (n = 1 par khatam hone wali transitions): ultraviolet hissa.
2. Balmer series (n = 2 par khatam hone wali transitions): visible (nazar aane wala) hissa.
(Teesri: Paschen series, n = 3 par khatam: infrared hissa.)

blocks.prompt:
18.10 What is meant by shift, and on witch factors does it depend?
Shift (Compton shift) se kya muraad hai, aur yeh kin cheezon par munhasir hai?
blocks.explanation:
Compton shift: electrons se scatter (bikhar) hone wali X-rays ke wavelength mein izafa: Δλ = λ′ − λ.
Δλ = (h/m₀c)(1 − cos θ)
Yeh sirf scattering angle θ par (θ = 0° par zero, 90° par h/m₀c = 2.43 × 10⁻¹² m, 180° par sab se zyada) aur scatter karne wale zarre ki rest mass m₀ par munhasir hai; incident (aane wale) wavelength par nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "witch" chhapa hai; sahi lafz "which" hai. Yahan "shift" se muraad Compton shift hai (Section 18.3).
Constructed Response Questions (wazahati jawab)

blocks.prompt:
18.1 Why do solids give rise to a continuous spectrum while hot vapours emit line spectrum?
Thos (solid) cheezein continuous spectrum kyun deti hain jab ke garam vapours (bukharat) line spectrum kharij karte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Garam vapours (kam pressure ki gas): atoms ek doosre se door aur taqreeban akele hain, is liye har atom ke apne alag (discrete) energy levels qaim rehte hain. Electrons sirf in levels ke darmiyan chhalaang lagate hain aur sirf khaas energy hf = E₂ − E₁ ke photons nikalte hain: alag alag tez lines, yani line spectrum.
Garam solids: atoms bohat qareeb aur aapas mein zor se asar daalte hain, is liye un ke energy levels phail kar bohat qareeb qareeb levels (bands) ban jate hain. Taqreeban har energy ki transition mumkin hai, is liye har wavelength nikalta hai aur rang aapas mein mil jate hain: continuous spectrum. (Solids ki band wali tasveer chapter se bahar hai.)

blocks.prompt:
18.2 Light can emit electrons from a metal surface and light can also be diffracted. Comment on the statement.
Light metal ki satah se electrons nikaal sakti hai aur light diffract bhi ho sakti hai. Is bayan par tabsira karein.
blocks.explanation:
Bayan durust hai; yeh light ki dohri (dual) nature dikhata hai.
1. Electrons ka nikalna (photoelectric effect) sirf tab samajh aata hai jab light photons ho, har ek ki energy hf, jo akele electron mein jazb hota hai: particle nature.
2. Diffraction (aur interference) sirf tab samajh aata hai jab light wave ho: wave nature.
Is liye light dono nature rakhti hai (wave-particle duality). Principle of complementarity ke mutabiq poori tasveer ke liye dono roop zaroori hain, magar ek experiment ek hi roop dikhata hai: light wave ki tarah safar karti hai aur matter se zarron ki tarah takrati hai.

blocks.prompt:
18.3 Why X-rays have different properties form light even though both originate from the transition of elections between different energy levels in excited atoms? Describe briefly.
X-rays ki khasiyatein light se mukhtalif kyun hain jab ke dono excited atoms mein electrons ki mukhtalif energy levels ke darmiyan transition se paida hoti hain? Mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Photon ki energy transition ke energy farq ke barabar hoti hai: hf = E_upper − E_lower.
1. Visible light bahar wale (outer) electrons ki transitions se aati hai, jahan levels ka farq sirf chand eV hai, is liye photons ki energy aur frequency kam aur wavelength lamba (taqreeban 400–700 nm) hota hai.
2. X-rays bhaari atoms ke andar wale (inner shells, jaise K aur L) electrons ki transitions se aati hain, jahan farq hazaron eV (keV) hai. Is liye X-ray photons ki energy aur frequency bohat zyada aur wavelength bohat chhota (taqreeban 10⁻¹⁰ m ya kam) hota hai.
Zyada photon energy ki wajah se X-rays light ke bar-aks cheezon ke paar guzar jati hain (penetrating) aur ionization karti hain. (Inner shells se X-rays banna chapter se bahar hai.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "form light" aur "elections" chhape hain; sahi alfaaz "from light" aur "electrons" hain.

blocks.prompt:
18.4 Is energy conserved when an atom emits a photon of light? Describe how.
Jab atom light ka photon kharij karta hai to kya energy mehfooz (conserve) rehti hai? Kaise, bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Excited atom tab photon nikaalta hai jab us ka electron oonche level Eₙ se neeche level Eₚ par girta hai. Atom bilkul utni energy khota hai jitni photon le jata hai:
hf = Eₙ − Eₚ
Is liye emission se pehle aur baad (atom + photon) ki kul energy barabar rehti hai. Isi liye har line ki frequency muqarrar hai: f = (Eₙ − Eₚ)/h. (Atom ke peechhe hatne (recoil) ki energy bohat kam hai, nazar-andaz.)

blocks.prompt:
18.5 How can spectrum of hydrogen atom contains many spectral lines when hydrogen atom contains one electron only?
Hydrogen atom mein sirf ek electron hai, phir bhi us ke spectrum mein bohat si lines kaise hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen gas ke namoone mein be-shumaar atoms hote hain. Discharge mein mukhtalif atoms mukhtalif levels (n = 2, 3, 4, ...) tak excite hote hain, aur un ke electrons mukhtalif raaston se neeche aate hain, seedhe ya qadam ba qadam (misal 3 → 2, 4 → 2, 2 → 1, 3 → 1, 4 → 3). Har qisam ki transition ek muqarrar wavelength ka photon deti hai, hf = Eₙ − Eₚ, yani ek line. Yeh sab transitions mukhtalif atoms mein ek saath hoti hain, is liye spectrum mein bohat si lines series (Lyman, Balmer, Paschen) ki shakal mein nazar aati hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Socho ek seedhi (stairs) hai aur hazaron bachay (atoms). Har bacha ek hi hai (ek electron), magar koi teesri seedhi se doosri par kooda, koi chauthi se doosri par, koi doosri se pehli par. Har chhalaang ka farq alag hai, is liye har chhalaang ka photon alag rang (wavelength) ka hai. Sab bachon ki chhalaangein mil kar bohat si lines bana deti hain.

blocks.prompt:
18.6 What should be the speed of an electron if it is to be confined in a box of the size of a nucleus?
Agar electron ko nucleus jitne size ke dabbe mein band karna ho to us ki speed kitni honi chahiye?
blocks.explanation:
Nucleus ka size: Δx ≈ 10⁻¹⁵ m. Uncertainty principle se:
Δp ≈ h/Δx = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s)/(10⁻¹⁵ m) = 6.63 × 10⁻¹⁹ kg m s⁻¹
Δv = Δp/m = (6.63 × 10⁻¹⁹)/(9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg) ≈ 7.3 × 10¹¹ m s⁻¹
Yeh light ki speed (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹) se bhi zyada hai, jo na-mumkin hai. Relativity ke saath dekhein to electron ko taqreeban light ki speed se aur GeV darje ki energy (E ≈ pc ≈ 2 × 10⁻¹⁰ J ≈ 1.2 GeV) ke saath harkat karni paregi. Atoms mein aisa electron nahi milta, is liye electron nucleus mein band nahi reh sakta.

blocks.prompt:
18.7 An incident X-ray on a metal surface is scattered. What is the wavelength, frequency, energy and speed of the scattered X-ray as compared to incident X-ray?
Metal ki satah par parne wali X-ray scatter hoti hai. Scatter hone wali X-ray ka wavelength, frequency, energy aur speed aane wali X-ray ke muqable mein kaisa hai?
blocks.explanation:
Compton scattering mein photon apni kuch energy peechhe hatne wale (recoil) electron ko de deta hai, is liye scatter hone wali X-ray ka wavelength lamba, frequency kam aur energy kam hoti hai; speed wahi (c) rehti hai:
λ′ = λ + (h/m₀c)(1 − cos θ)

rows: Wavelength λ
Lamba: λ′ = λ + Δλ
Frequency f = c/λ
Kam: f′ = c/λ′ < f
Energy hf
Kam: hf′ = hf − recoil electron ki K.E.
Speed c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
Wahi speed c
Momentum h/λ
Kam: h/λ′

blocks.prompt:
18.8 Why does energy and momentum conservation play a key role in driving Compton's effect?
Compton effect ko derive (akhaz) karne mein energy aur momentum ki conservation ka aham kirdar kyun hai?
blocks.explanation:
Compton ne scattering ko X-ray photon (energy hc/λ, momentum h/λ) aur rukay hue electron ke darmiyan elastic takkar samjha, jaise do billiard balls.
1. Energy ki conservation: hc/λ − hc/λ′ = (m − m₀)c² (photon ki khoi hui energy electron ki K.E. ban jati hai).
2. Momentum ki conservation, x-component: h/λ = (h/λ′) cos θ + mv cos φ; y-component: 0 = (h/λ′) sin θ − mv sin φ.
In equations ko hal karne se Compton shift Δλ = (h/m₀c)(1 − cos θ) milta hai, jo experiment se poori tarah milta hai. Classical wave theory yeh shift nahi samjha sakti, is liye in conservation laws ki kamyabi sabit karti hai ke photon momentum rakhta hai aur zarre ki tarah bartao karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "driving" chhapa hai; sahi lafz "deriving" (Compton shift ko akhaz karna) hai, aur "does" ki jagah "do" hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
18.9 Describe how a line emission spectrum leads to an understanding of the existence of discrete electron energy levels in atoms.
Bayan karein ke line emission spectrum se atoms mein electrons ke alag alag (discrete) energy levels ka wujood kaise samajh aata hai.
blocks.explanation:
1. Kisi element ka emission spectrum (misal discharge tube mein hydrogen) continuous nahi hota; sirf khaas muqarrar wavelengths ki tez lines hoti hain.
2. Har line ek hi energy ke photons se banti hai: hf = hc/λ = Eₙ − Eₚ, yani do energy levels ka farq.
3. Agar electron ki koi bhi energy ho sakti to har farq mumkin hota aur continuous spectrum banta. Chunke sirf khaas wavelengths aati hain, is liye electron sirf khaas discrete (alag alag) energies rakh sakta hai.
4. Wavelengths poore adad (whole numbers) wale aasan formulas par chalti hain, misal Balmer: 1/λ = R_H(1/2² − 1/n²), n = 3, 4, 5, ...; yeh n ijazat shuda energy levels ke number hain (n = 1 ground state, n = 2, 3, ... excited states).
5. Absorption lines bhi inhi wavelengths par aati hain, jo inhi muqarrar levels ki tasdeeq hai.

blocks.prompt:
18.10 Mass of a photon is considered zero, then how does the photon possess momentum? Describe.
Photon ki mass zero maani jati hai, phir photon momentum kaise rakhta hai? Bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Photon ki rest mass (rukne ki halat ki mass) zero hai, magar woh hamesha speed c se chalta hai aur energy E = hf rakhta hai. Relativity ke mutabiq energy aur mass barabar hain (E = mc²), is liye chalte photon ki mass ke barabar m = E/c² aur momentum p = mc hai:
E = pc, yani p = E/c = hf/c = h/λ
Yani photon ka momentum us ki energy se aata hai, rest mass se nahi. Compton effect is ka saboot hai: photon electron ko takrane wale zarre ki tarah momentum deta hai.

blocks.text: Comprehensive Questions (tafseeli jawab)

blocks.prompt:
18.1 Explain photoelectric effect, its experimental arrangements and observations. Deduce photoelectric equation; hf = φ + 1/2 mv²max.
Photoelectric effect, us ka experimental intezam aur mushahidaat bayan karein. Photoelectric equation hf = φ + 1/2 mv²max akhaz (deduce) karein.
blocks.explanation:
Photoelectric effect: jab munasib frequency (ya wavelength) ki light metal ki satah par parti hai to us se electrons nikalte hain. In electrons ko photoelectrons kehte hain.
Experimental intezam:
1. Khali (evacuated) sheeshe ki tube mein do electrodes hain: metal ka cathode C (battery ke negative terminal se) aur anode A (positive terminal se), potential divider aur micro-ammeter ke zariye.
2. Jab munasib frequency ki ek-rangi (monochromatic) light C par parti hai to electrons nikal kar A ki taraf jate hain aur micro-ammeter current dikhata hai (photoelectric current). Light band karne par current ruk jata hai.
3. Battery ulti karne se A negative ho jata hai: electrons peechhe dhakele jate hain aur current kam hota hai. Ek khaas negative potential V₀ (stopping potential) par current zero ho jata hai; sab se tez electrons bhi A tak nahi pohanchte. Is liye (K.E.)max = ½mv²max = V₀e.
Mushahidaat:
1. Intensity zyada (frequency wahi) karne se current barhta hai magar wahi V₀ par rukta hai (Fig. 18.2): intensity sirf electrons ki tadaad tay karti hai.
2. Intensity wahi aur frequency badalne se current wahi magar V₀ alag (Fig. 18.3): frequency barhne se (K.E.)max barhti hai.
3. Electrons mukhtalif energies se nikalte hain; (K.E.)max metal aur frequency par munhasir hai.
4. Har metal ki ek threshold frequency f₀ hai jis se kam par light kitni bhi tez ho, electron nahi nikalta (misal: neeli light sodium se electrons nikaalti hai, laal nahi).
5. Electrons foran (bina deir) nikalte hain.
Wave theory yeh natije nahi samjha sakti (us ke mutabiq intensity se K.E. barhni chahiye, threshold nahi hona chahiye aur deir honi chahiye).
Photoelectric equation (Einstein):
1. Light photons par mushtamil hai, har ek ki energy E = hf.
2. Photon akele electron mein jazb hota hai. Electron ko metal se nikalne ke liye kam se kam energy φ (work function) chahiye.
3. Photon energy ka kuch hissa nikalne mein lagta hai, baqi kinetic energy banta hai; seedhe nikalne wale electrons ke liye yeh maximum hai:
Photon ki energy − work function = (K.E.)max
hf − φ = ½mv²max
hf = φ + ½mv²max
4. Threshold par (K.E.)max = 0 aur f = f₀: φ = hf₀. Is liye (K.E.)max = hf − hf₀ = V₀e.
(K.E.)max aur f ka graph seedhi line hai jis ka slope h hai aur jo frequency axis ko f₀ par kaatti hai. Photoelectric effect light ki particle nature dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Photon ko ek sikka samjho aur work function ko darwaze ki fees. Agar sikka fees se kam hai (f < f₀) to koi electron bahar nahi ja sakta, chahe kitne hi chhote sikke (zyada intensity) aa jayein. Agar sikka bara hai to fees de kar baqi paise (energy) electron ki kinetic energy ban jate hain: hf = φ + ½mv²max. Zyada sikke (intensity) = zyada electrons; bara sikka (frequency) = zyada K.E.

blocks.prompt:
18.2 Describe de-Broglie waves associated with material particles and discuss wave particle duality.
Maaddi zarron (material particles) ke saath de-Broglie waves bayan karein aur wave particle duality par behas karein.
blocks.explanation:
de Broglie waves:
1. Light dohri nature dikhati hai. Qudrat mein yaksaniyat (symmetry) maan kar Louis de Broglie (1924) ne kaha ke maaddi zarron mein bhi wave ki khasiyat honi chahiye.
2. Photon ka momentum p = h/λ hai. Unhon ne mass m aur velocity v wale zarre ke liye bhi yahi rishta tajweez kiya:
p = mv = h/λ, yani λ = h/p = h/mv (de Broglie relation)
3. Bari cheezon ka λ na hone ke barabar hai: 20 g goli 330 m s⁻¹ par, λ ≈ 1 × 10⁻³⁴ m, naapna na-mumkin. 1 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ wale electron ka λ ≈ 7 × 10⁻¹⁰ m, X-rays ki range mein, is liye us ka diffraction naapa ja sakta hai.
4. Experimental saboot (Davisson aur Germer): garam filament se nikle electrons ko V se tez kar ke nickel crystal par daala gaya; scatter hone wale electrons baqaida peaks mein aaye, X-rays jaisa diffraction pattern. ½mv² = Ve se mv = √(2mVe) aur λ = h/√(2mVe). V = 54 V par λ = 1.66 × 10⁻¹⁰ m; Bragg ka qanoon 2d sin θ = mλ (d = 0.91 × 10⁻¹⁰ m, θ = 65°) λ = 1.65 × 10⁻¹⁰ m deta hai, behtareen mutabiqat. Protons, neutrons aur hydrogen aur helium atoms ka diffraction bhi dekha gaya hai.
Wave-particle duality:
1. Light: interference aur diffraction wave nature; photoelectric aur Compton effect particle nature dikhate hain.
2. Matter: electron diffraction (Davisson-Germer, G. P. Thomson) electrons ki wave nature; J. J. Thomson ka e/m experiment unhein zarre maanta hai.
3. Is liye matter aur radiation dono dohri wave-particle nature rakhte hain. Bohr ka principle of complementarity: poori tasveer ke liye dono roop zaroori hain, magar ek experiment mein dono kabhi ek saath nazar nahi aate; experiment tay karta hai kaun sa roop aayega (grating light ko wave, metal ki satah zarre dikhati hai).
4. Tamam chhote zarre waves ki tarah safar karte hain aur zarron ki tarah energy ka len-den karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
18.3 Explain the appearance and formation of emission and absorption of line spectra from excited atoms. How can they be used to identify the presence of varies elements in a mixture of vapours?
Excited atoms se emission aur absorption line spectra ka zahir hona aur banna bayan karein. Vapours ke mixture mein mukhtalif elements ki mojoodgi pehchanne ke liye inhein kaise istemal kiya ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Emission line spectrum:
1. Intezam: gas ya vapour wali discharge tube ki light ko diffraction grating wale spectrometer se guzara jata hai.
2. Shakal: andheri background par muqarrar wavelengths ki tez roshan lines ka silsila nazar aata hai.
3. Banna: discharge mein atoms energy jazb karte hain aur un ke electrons oonche (excited) levels par chale jate hain. Excited halat bohat thori deir rehti hai; electrons neeche levels par aa kar hf = Eₙ − Eₚ energy ke photons nikalte hain. Sirf khaas energy farq mojood hain, is liye sirf khaas wavelengths (lines) aati hain. Hydrogen ke liye: Lyman series (n = 1 par khatam, ultraviolet), Balmer series 1/λ = R_H(1/2² − 1/n²) (n = 2 par khatam, visible), Paschen series (n = 3 par khatam, infrared).
Absorption line spectrum:
1. Shakal: jab safed light (continuous spectrum) kam pressure ki gas se guzarti hai to continuous spectrum mein khaas wavelengths par andheri lines aa jati hain.
2. Banna: gas atoms ke electrons sirf woh photons jazb karte hain jin ki energy kisi oopar wali transition Eₙ − Eₚ ke bilkul barabar ho. Yeh wavelengths light se nikal jati hain (har taraf dobara kharij hoti hain), is liye un ki jagah andheri lines reh jati hain.
3. Absorption spectrum mein ghaib wavelengths bilkul wahi hain jo usi element ke emission spectrum mein mojood hain (Fig. 18.13).
Mixture mein elements ki pehchan:
1. Har element ke apne energy levels hain, is liye us ka line spectrum finger print ki tarah munfarid (unique) hai.
2. Excited mixture ka spectrum (ya us se guzri light ka absorption spectrum) record kar ke lines ki wavelengths naapi jati hain.
3. In lines ka elements ke maloom spectra se muqabla kiya jata hai. Agar kisi element ki sab khaas lines mojood hon to woh element mixture mein hai (misal: 589 nm ke qareeb do peeli lines sodium batati hain). Lines ki chamak se miqdaar ka andaza bhi hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "varies elements" chhapa hai; sahi alfaaz "various elements" (mukhtalif elements) hain.

blocks.prompt:
18.4 Describe the transmission of electron microscope. What are the similarities and differences between electron microscope and an optical microscope?
Transmission electron microscope bayan karein. Electron microscope aur optical microscope mein kya mushabihat (similarities) aur farq hain?
blocks.explanation:
Transmission electron microscope (TEM):
1. Usool: yeh electrons ki wave nature istemal karta hai. Tez electrons ka de Broglie wavelength visible light se hazaron guna chhota hai, is liye microscope bohat baareek tafseel (nanometre, taqreeban atomic level tak) dikha sakta hai. Electrons jitne tez, wavelength utna chhota aur resolution (baareeki dikhane ki salahiyat) utni zyada.
2. Source: garam filament (electron gun) se electrons nikal kar bohat oonchi voltage se vacuum mein tez kiye jate hain.
3. Condenser lens: electromagnetic lens beam ko patle specimen par focus karta hai. Electrons specimen ke paar guzarte (transmit hote) hain.
4. Objective lens: electromagnetic lens specimen ki image banata hai.
5. Projector lens: electromagnetic lens image ko mazeed bara kar ke fluorescent screen ya photographic film par daalta hai; is tasveer ko micrograph kehte hain.
(Jadeed scanning electron microscope teen-dimensional image dete hain.) Istemal: cells, viruses aur bacteria, dhaaton ke toot (fractures), materials aur crystal structure ka mutala.
Mushabihat: dono cheez ki bari image banate hain; dono mein condenser beam ko specimen par focus karta hai, objective image banata hai aur ek aur lens (projector ya eyepiece) use bara karta hai; dono mein resolution istemal hone wali wave ke wavelength se mehdood hai.
Farq table mein hain.

rows: Electrons ki beam (matter waves) istemal hoti hai
Visible light istemal hoti hai
Wavelength light se hazaron guna chhota
Visible light ka wavelength (taqreeban 400–700 nm)
Bohat zyada resolution: nanometre (taqreeban atomic) level tak tafseel
Kam resolution: light ke wavelength se chhoti tafseel nahi dikhti
Electromagnetic (magnetic) lens; current badal kar focus
Sheeshe ke lens; lens hila kar focus
Vacuum mein kaam; bohat oonchi voltage chahiye
Hawa mein kaam; oonchi voltage nahi chahiye
Image fluorescent screen par ya tasveer (micrograph)
Image seedhi aankh se dekhi jati hai
Patle, be-jaan specimen vacuum mein
Zinda specimen bhi dekhe ja sakte hain

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "the transmission of electron microscope" chhapa hai; sahi matlab "the transmission electron microscope" (Fig. 18.8 wala TEM) hai.

blocks.prompt:
18.5 State and explain uncertainty principle. What is its significance in particle physics?
Uncertainty principle bayan karein aur samjhayein. Particle physics mein is ki kya ahmiyat hai?
blocks.explanation:
Bayan (Heisenberg, 1927): kisi zarre ki position aur momentum dono ek saath bilkul durust nahi naape ja sakte. Ek hi waqt par position ki uncertainty Δx aur momentum ke x-component ki uncertainty Δp ka hasil-e-zarb taqreeban Planck's constant ke barabar hai:
Δx Δp ≈ h
Wazahat:
1. Yeh uncertainty aale (instrument) ki kharabi nahi; yeh matter aur radiation ki wave-particle duality ka natija hai.
2. Chhote zarre ki jagah maloom karne ke liye wavelength λ ki light chahiye. Light wave hai, is liye position sirf taqreeban ek wavelength tak maloom hoti hai: Δx ≈ λ.
3. Istemal hone wale photon ka momentum h/λ hai jo poora zarre ko mil sakta hai, is liye zarre ke momentum mein Δp ≈ h/λ ki uncertainty aa jati hai.
4. Zarb dene se: Δx Δp ≈ λ(h/λ) ≈ h.
5. Chhota wavelength Δx kam magar Δp zyada karta hai, aur ulat: dono ek saath kam nahi ho sakte.
6. Heisenberg ke mazeed durust hisaab se behtareen soorat mein Δx Δp ≥ ħ, jahan ħ = h/2π = 1.05 × 10⁻³⁴ J s.
7. Energy-time shakal: ΔE Δt ≈ h (ΔE Δt ≥ ħ). Energy jitni durust maloom ho, woh energy rakhne ka waqt utna ghair yaqeeni.
8. Bari cheezon ke liye yeh uncertainty na hone ke barabar hai (photons urti tennis ball ko mushkil se asar karte hain), magar atomic duniya mein ghalib hai (ek photon electron ki harkat bilkul badal deta hai).
Particle physics mein ahmiyat:
1. Sabit karta hai ke electron nucleus ke andar nahi reh sakta: Δx ≈ 10⁻¹⁵ m se Δp ≈ 6.63 × 10⁻¹⁹ kg m s⁻¹, jis ke liye GeV darje ki energy chahiye jo atom ke kisi electron ke paas nahi.
2. Spectral lines ki qudrati chaurai (width) samjhata hai: taqreeban 10⁻⁸ s rehne wali excited halat ka ΔE ≈ h/Δt ≈ 4 × 10⁻⁷ eV.
3. Atomic duniya mein naap ki bunyadi had muqarrar karta hai, is liye chhote zarron ki harkat yaqeeni raaston ke bajaye probability (imkaan) se bayan hoti hai; bohat kam cheezein 100% yaqeen se batai ja sakti hain.
4. Samjhata hai ke bohat chhoti cheezon ko jaanchne ke liye chhote wavelength (zyada energy wale zarre ya photons) kyun chahiye.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Andheray kamre mein ek chhoti si gend dhoondni ho aur aap ke paas sirf doosri gendein phenkne ka tareeqa ho. Jab aap ki gend us se takrati hai to aap ko pata chal jata hai ke woh kahan thi, magar takkar se woh hil bhi jati hai, ab us ki raftaar ghair yaqeeni hai. Electron ke saath photon yahi karta hai: jagah jitni durust, momentum utna ghair yaqeeni.
Numerical Problems (sawal hal karein)

blocks.prompt:
18.1 A photon has wavelength 350 nm. What is its energy in joules and also in eV? (Ans: 5.68 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, 3.55 eV)
Ek photon ka wavelength 350 nm hai. Us ki energy joules aur eV mein kitni hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: λ = 350 nm = 350 × 10⁻⁹ m, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
Maloom karna: E (J aur eV mein)
E = hf = hc/λ
E = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(350 × 10⁻⁹ m)
E = 5.68 × 10⁻¹⁹ J
1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, is liye:
E = (5.68 × 10⁻¹⁹)/(1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹) eV = 3.55 eV
Jawab: E = 5.68 × 10⁻¹⁹ J = 3.55 eV (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
18.2 A certain atom has a separation in energy of 3 × 10⁻¹⁸ J between two of its energy levels. What frequency photon is required to make the atom change from the lower state to higher state? (Ans: 4.5 × 10¹⁴ Hz)
Ek atom ke do energy levels ke darmiyan 3 × 10⁻¹⁸ J ka farq hai. Atom ko neeche wali halat se oopar wali halat mein le jane ke liye kitni frequency ka photon chahiye?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: ΔE = 3 × 10⁻¹⁸ J, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s
Maloom karna: f
Photon ki energy levels ke farq ke barabar honi chahiye: hf = ΔE
f = ΔE/h
f = (3 × 10⁻¹⁸ J)/(6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s)
f = 4.52 × 10¹⁵ Hz ≈ 4.5 × 10¹⁵ Hz
Jawab: f = 4.5 × 10¹⁵ Hz (kitab 4.5 × 10¹⁴ Hz likhti hai; box dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 4.5 × 10¹⁴ Hz likhti hai. f = ΔE/h = (3 × 10⁻¹⁸ J)/(6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s) = 4.5 × 10¹⁵ Hz banta hai; chhape jawab mein power of ten ek kam hai (woh jawab ΔE = 3 × 10⁻¹⁹ J se aata).

blocks.prompt:
18.3 What is the wavelength of photon with an energy of 10 × 10⁻¹⁹ J? (124 nm) (Ans: 1.99 × 10⁻⁷ m)
10 × 10⁻¹⁹ J energy wale photon ka wavelength kitna hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: E = 10 × 10⁻¹⁹ J = 1 × 10⁻¹⁸ J, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
Maloom karna: λ
E = hc/λ, is liye λ = hc/E
λ = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(1 × 10⁻¹⁸ J)
λ = 1.99 × 10⁻⁷ m = 199 nm
Jawab: λ = 1.99 × 10⁻⁷ m (kitab ke jawab se milta hai; sawal mein chhapa "(124 nm)" nahi milta; box dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "(124 nm)" bhi chhapa hai jo chhape jawab 1.99 × 10⁻⁷ m (= 199 nm) ke khilaf hai. E = 10 × 10⁻¹⁹ J ke liye wavelength 199 nm hai; 124 nm to 10 eV (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁸ J) wale photon ka wavelength hota.

blocks.prompt:
18.4 Calculate the threshold frequency for sodium metal whose work function is 2.28 eV and the value of h is 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s. (Ans: 5.5 × 10¹⁴ Hz)
Sodium metal ki threshold frequency maloom karein jis ka work function 2.28 eV aur h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s hai.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: φ = 2.28 eV = 2.28 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J = 3.65 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s
Maloom karna: f₀
φ = hf₀, is liye f₀ = φ/h
f₀ = (3.65 × 10⁻¹⁹ J)/(6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s)
f₀ = 5.5 × 10¹⁴ Hz
Jawab: f₀ = 5.5 × 10¹⁴ Hz (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
18.5 What can be the longest wavelength for photoelectric emission from tungsten if its work function is 4.54 eV. (Ans: 273 nm)
Agar tungsten ka work function 4.54 eV ho to photoelectric emission ke liye sab se lamba wavelength kitna ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: φ = 4.54 eV = 4.54 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J = 7.26 × 10⁻¹⁹ J
Maloom karna: sab se lamba (threshold) wavelength λ₀
Sab se lamba wavelength threshold frequency wala hai: φ = hf₀ = hc/λ₀
λ₀ = hc/φ
λ₀ = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(7.26 × 10⁻¹⁹ J)
λ₀ = 2.74 × 10⁻⁷ m ≈ 274 nm
Jawab: λ₀ ≈ 2.7 × 10⁻⁷ m (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s aur c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ se 274 nm; kitab ka 273 nm zyada durust constants se aata hai, is liye jawab milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
18.6 An electron is accelerated in an evacuated tube from rest through a potential difference of 550 V. What will be its final momentum? Calculate the wavelength associate with this electron. (Ans: 1.27 × 10⁻²³ N s, 5.22 × 10⁻¹¹ m)
Ek electron khali tube mein aaram se 550 V ke potential difference se tez kiya jata hai. Us ka aakhri momentum kitna hoga? Is electron ka (associated) wavelength maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: V = 550 V, m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, aaram (rest) se shuru
Maloom karna: p aur λ
Haasil shuda K.E.: ½mv² = Ve
Is liye mv = √(2mVe)
p = √(2 × 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg × 550 V × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)
p = √(1.60 × 10⁻⁴⁶)
p = 1.27 × 10⁻²³ N s (kg m s⁻¹)
de Broglie wavelength: λ = h/p
λ = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s)/(1.27 × 10⁻²³ N s)
λ = 5.22 × 10⁻¹¹ m
Jawab: p = 1.27 × 10⁻²³ N s, λ = 5.22 × 10⁻¹¹ m (kitab se milta hai; p ko gol kiye baghair 5.24 × 10⁻¹¹ m aata hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "associate" chhapa hai; sahi lafz "associated" hai (is electron se wabasta wavelength).

blocks.prompt:
18.7 The position of a free electron is determined with an uncertainty of 10⁻⁷ m. What is the uncertainty in its velocity? What would be the position of an electron after one second? (Ans: 6 × 10² m s⁻¹, anywhere within a distance of 6 × 10² m)
Ek azaad electron ki position 10⁻⁷ m ki uncertainty se maloom ki gayi. Us ki velocity mein uncertainty kitni hai? Ek second baad electron ki position kya hogi?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: Δx = 10⁻⁷ m, m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, t = 1 s
Maloom karna: Δv, aur 1 s baad position
Chapter ki shakal Δx Δp ≈ h se (Example 18.4 ki tarah), Δp = mΔv:
Δv ≈ h/(mΔx)
Δv ≈ (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s)/(9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg × 10⁻⁷ m)
Δv ≈ 7.3 × 10³ m s⁻¹
1 s baad position: velocity mein Δv ki uncertainty hai, is liye 1 s mein tay kiye faasle mein Δv × t ki uncertainty hogi:
Δx′ = Δv × t = 7.3 × 10³ m s⁻¹ × 1 s ≈ 7.3 × 10³ m
Yani ek second baad electron taqreeban 7 × 10³ m ke andar kahin bhi ho sakta hai.
Kitab ka jawab Δx Δp ≥ h/4π (= ħ/2) wali shakal se hai, jo chapter mein nahi (chapter se bahar):
Δv ≥ h/(4πmΔx) = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴)/(4π × 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ × 10⁻⁷) ≈ 5.8 × 10² m s⁻¹ ≈ 6 × 10² m s⁻¹
aur 1 s baad: 6 × 10² m ke andar kahin bhi.
Jawab: Δv ≈ 7.3 × 10³ m s⁻¹ aur position ≈ 7 × 10³ m ke andar kahin bhi (Δx Δp ≈ h se); kitab ke 6 × 10² m s⁻¹ aur 6 × 10² m Δx Δp ≥ h/4π se aate hain (box dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke jawab (6 × 10² m s⁻¹, 6 × 10² m) chapter ke rishte Δx Δp ≈ h (Eq. 18.14, Example 18.4 mein istemal) se nahi aate; us se Δv ≈ 7.3 × 10³ m s⁻¹ aur taqreeban 7 × 10³ m aata hai. Kitab ke jawab Δx Δp ≥ h/4π (ħ/2) wali shakal se aate hain jo chapter mein nahi di gayi. Dono hal oopar diye gaye hain; imtehan mein chapter wala tareeqa (Δx Δp ≈ h) likhein.

blocks.prompt:
18.8 A stationary nickel nucleus of mass 9.95 × 10⁻²⁶ kg emits a photon of energy 1.17 MeV. Find:
(i) the wavelength of the photon and its momentum.
(ii) the speed of the nucleus after the emission of photon.
(Ans: (I) 1.06 × 10⁻¹² m, 6.25 × 10⁻²² N s, (ii) 6.29 × 10³ m s⁻¹)
Rukay hue nickel nucleus (mass 9.95 × 10⁻²⁶ kg) se 1.17 MeV energy ka photon nikalta hai. Maloom karein: (i) photon ka wavelength aur momentum; (ii) photon nikalne ke baad nucleus ki speed.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: M = 9.95 × 10⁻²⁶ kg (aaram mein), E = 1.17 MeV = 1.17 × 10⁶ × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J = 1.87 × 10⁻¹³ J
Maloom karna: (i) photon ka λ aur p, (ii) nucleus ki peechhe hatne (recoil) ki speed v
(i) E = hc/λ, is liye λ = hc/E
λ = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(1.87 × 10⁻¹³ J)
λ = 1.06 × 10⁻¹² m
p = h/λ = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s)/(1.06 × 10⁻¹² m)
p = 6.25 × 10⁻²² N s
(ii) Momentum ki conservation: nucleus pehle aaram mein tha, is liye baad mein nucleus aur photon ke momentum barabar aur ulte hain:
Mv = p
v = p/M = (6.25 × 10⁻²² N s)/(9.95 × 10⁻²⁶ kg)
v = 6.28 × 10³ m s⁻¹ ≈ 6.3 × 10³ m s⁻¹
Jawab: (i) λ = 1.06 × 10⁻¹² m, p = 6.25 × 10⁻²² N s; (ii) v ≈ 6.3 × 10³ m s⁻¹ (kitab ke 6.29 × 10³ m s⁻¹ se gol karne ke farq ke saath milta hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yeh bandooq aur goli jaisa hai: goli (photon) aage jati hai to bandooq (nucleus) peechhe dhakka khati hai. Shuru mein kul momentum zero tha, is liye baad mein bhi zero: photon ka momentum p aage, nucleus ka Mv peechhe, Mv = p.

blocks.prompt:
18.9 The work function of a metal is 3.5 eV. Light of wavelength 450 nm is incident on the surface. Find out whether electrons will be emitted by the photoelectric effect, from the surface. (Ans: Electrons will not be emitted)
Ek metal ka work function 3.5 eV hai. 450 nm wavelength ki light us ki satah par parti hai. Maloom karein ke photoelectric effect se electrons niklenge ya nahi.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: φ = 3.5 eV, λ = 450 nm = 450 × 10⁻⁹ m
Maloom karna: kya hf ≥ φ hai?
E = hc/λ
E = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(450 × 10⁻⁹ m)
E = 4.42 × 10⁻¹⁹ J
E = (4.42 × 10⁻¹⁹)/(1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹) eV = 2.76 eV
2.76 eV < 3.5 eV (photon ki energy work function se kam), is liye koi electron nahi nikal sakta.
(Doosra tareeqa: threshold wavelength λ₀ = hc/φ = 1.99 × 10⁻²⁵/(5.6 × 10⁻¹⁹) = 355 nm, aur 450 nm is se lamba hai.)
Jawab: Electrons nahi niklenge (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
18.10 A 90 keV X-ray photon is fired at a carbon target and Compton scattering occurs. Find the wavelength of the incident photon and the wavelength of the scattered photon for scattering angle of (a) 30° (b) 60°. (Ans: 13.8 pm (a) 14.1 pm (b) 15 pm)
90 keV ka X-ray photon carbon target par phenka jata hai aur Compton scattering hoti hai. Aane wale photon ka wavelength aur (a) 30° (b) 60° scattering angle par scatter hone wale photon ka wavelength maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: E = 90 keV = 90 × 10³ × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J = 1.44 × 10⁻¹⁴ J, Compton wavelength h/m₀c = 2.43 × 10⁻¹² m = 2.43 pm
Maloom karna: λ, aur θ = 30° aur 60° par λ′
Aane wala wavelength: λ = hc/E
λ = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(1.44 × 10⁻¹⁴ J)
λ = 1.38 × 10⁻¹¹ m = 13.8 pm
Compton shift: Δλ = (h/m₀c)(1 − cos θ), λ′ = λ + Δλ
(a) θ = 30°: 1 − cos 30° = 1 − 0.866 = 0.134
Δλ = 2.43 pm × 0.134 = 0.33 pm
λ′ = 13.8 pm + 0.33 pm = 14.1 pm
(b) θ = 60°: 1 − cos 60° = 1 − 0.5 = 0.5
Δλ = 2.43 pm × 0.5 = 1.22 pm
λ′ = 13.8 pm + 1.22 pm = 15.0 pm
